changed: Device Sync now converges steady-state edits through one guarded pass, queues at most one follow-up, protects newer local edits from stale inbound snapshots, negotiates only final-manifest blobs after apply, rejects inbound non-shareable custom-field data, settles pending work before shutdown, stops before publication until local attach state exists, reuses unchanged peer manifests and verified blobs, and pauses for confirmation instead of silently recreating a missing collection.

Add existence-first, baseline-aware classification-safe merge and transactional inbound-apply primitives for Device Sync, including conditional custom-field egress validation, tombstone-safe relation validation, per-owner dependent-row collision guards, and optimistic protection against overwriting concurrent local edits.
